ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Autonomous taxis are already being tested. Will school bus drivers be replaced? That is unlikely in the near term, but the boundaries of driver responsibility are changing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 387,300 bus drivers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to increase to 388,200 by 2034, a net gain of about 900 jobs, with approximately 61,000 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $47,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI's impact on Bus Drivers, School is a long-term possibility with little near-term effect. Route planning, scheduling, and vehicle monitoring are already intelligent, but school buses carry children through mixed urban traffic. Autonomous driving will struggle to meet school-bus safety standards for a long time. The role is shifting from driving alone toward driving plus student care plus final safety responsibility. AI and monitoring systems assist rather than replace the driver.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent speed limiting and speeding alerts
ADAS driver assistance to reduce fatigue
Alerts from onboard student-activity monitoring
Pilots linking school-bus priority with traffic signals
ai_s2_auto: School-bus route planning and scheduling
Remote vehicle-condition monitoring
Automatic collection of driving records and mileage data
Boarding check-in and student-list verification
ai_s3_list: Safe driving: steady, accurate judgment in complex traffic and severe weather.
Student care: boarding order, seat belts, and incident response.
Responsibility: no lapse is acceptable when children are on board.
Emergency handling: on-site response to accidents, illness, or missing students.
Human communication: daily coordination with parents, schools, and attendants.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10, low-moderate, means intelligent systems are taking over route, scheduling, and monitoring tasks. Driving and student care dominate field work, so near-term AI replacement remains limited.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not permit complacency. School-bus oversight is tightening, and AI monitoring makes every violation visible. A driver's safety record determines career longevity. As pure driving loses relative value, fleets prefer drivers who care for students, understand emergencies, and maintain strong records.

ai_s5_persona.建议: School bus driving offers stable employment, but students do not need to specialize too early. Treat driving as a foundational skill and expand toward transit, freight, or fleet management to preserve more options.

Master intelligent monitoring and ADAS systems and take responsibility for student care and emergencies. Maintain an impeccable safety record and progress toward fleet lead or safety administrator roles for better pay and stability.

People with A/B licenses and stable driving experience transition most easily. Emphasize safe mileage, an accident-free record, and complete qualifications. School-bus operators prioritize applicants with clean backgrounds and calm temperaments.

Place safety records and psychological assessments before years of driving when selecting school bus drivers. Equip drivers with ADAS and monitoring systems, then define safety-performance rewards so safe operation creates measurable career value.

ai_s7_trends: School-bus oversight continues to tighten, intelligent monitoring becomes standard, and safety records determine career longevity.
A declining school-age population stabilizes routes, while rural school consolidation creates demand for longer routes.
Autonomous driving is unlikely to carry children soon, keeping driver roles stable.

body: Bus Drivers, School operate school buses on fixed routes to transport students to and from school. They conduct pre-trip safety inspections, stop and manage boarding correctly, follow school-bus markings and priority rules, and protect safety throughout the trip.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Autonomous taxis are already being tested. Will school bus drivers be replaced? That is unlikely in the near term, but the boundaries of driver responsibility are changing.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动驾驶连出租车都在试，校车会被取代吗？短期很难，但司机的责任边界在变。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年公交司机在岗约 38.73 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 38.82 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 6.10 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.70 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 对校车司机的冲击是「远期存在、近期很小」：路线规划、调度排班、车辆监控已经智能化，但接送的是儿童、跑的是城市混合路况，自动驾驶在很长一段时间内难以达到校车的安全标准。真正在变化的是司机的工作内容——从「只管开车」转向「开车 + 学生照护 + 安全兜底」，AI 和监控系统是帮手，不是替代者。
ai_s2_accel: 智能限速与超速预警系统
ADAS 辅助驾驶缓解疲劳
车内学生动态监控提醒
校车优先通行信号联动试点
ai_s2_auto: 校车路线规划与调度排班
车辆状态远程监控
行车记录与里程数据自动采集
上下车打卡与学生名单核验
ai_s3_list: 安全驾驶：复杂路况与恶劣天气下的稳准判断。
学生照护：上下车秩序、系安全带、突发状况处置。
责任心：车上坐的是孩子，任何疏忽都承担不起。
应急处理：事故、生病、走失等现场处置。
与人沟通：与家长、学校、照管员的日常协作。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明路线、调度、监控等系统环节正被智能化接管，但驾驶与照护现场占比高，AI 实际替代比例短期很低。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于可以松懈：校车监管趋严，AI 监控让每一次违规都无处遁形——安全记录就是校车司机的身家性命。同时智能化让「纯驾驶」的价值相对下降，「会照护、懂应急、记录良好」的复合型司机更受车队欢迎。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 校车司机适合作为稳定就业选项，但不必过早定向。趁年轻把驾驶作为基础能力，往公交、货运或车管方向拓宽，选择面更大。
把智能监控、ADAS 辅助系统用熟，主动承担照管与应急职责。安全记录保持零瑕疵，向车队长、安全管理员方向发展，收入与稳定性都能上一个台阶。
持 A/B 照且有稳定驾驶经历的人转型最顺。求职时强调安全里程、零事故记录和驾驶资格齐全，校车公司对背景干净、脾气稳的人优先。
选校车司机要把安全记录与心理评估放在第一位，驾驶年限其次。给司机配 ADAS 与监控设备，同时设计清晰的安全绩效奖励，让「安全」成为可量化的职业回报。

ai_s6_tools.工具: 车载 GPS 调度系统

ai_s7_trends: 校车监管持续收紧，智能化监控成为标配，安全记录决定职业生命。
学龄人口下降让线路平稳，乡镇撤并带来长线路需求。
自动驾驶短期难接载童场景，司机岗位保持稳定。

body: 校车司机负责驾驶校车按固定线路接送学生上下学：执行发车前安全检查、规范停靠与上下车照护、遵守校车专用标识与优先通行规则，保障全程行车安全。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动驾驶连出租车都在试，校车会被取代吗？短期很难，但司机的责任边界在变。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Machine vision can flag defects, but a skilled worker still decides how to clean an edge and finish an irregular shape.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 7,000 Cutters And Trimmers, Hand employed in 2024, projected to decline to 5,700 by 2034. That is a net decrease of about 1,300 jobs, with about 600 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $38,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace hand cutters and trimmers, but it will accelerate material cutting and inspection. Automated cutting and vision sorting speed up repetitive tasks, shifting workers toward precision finishing of irregular shapes, defect detection, on-the-spot correction, and quality control. Routine rough cutting and simple defect sorting face the most pressure, while irregular-shape finishing becomes more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted edge-trimming paths
Intelligent defect-feature recognition
Process-parameter recommendations
Quality-trend analysis
ai_s2_auto: Automated material cutting
Machine-vision defect sorting
Automated dimensional-tolerance inspection
Automated stacking for material movement
ai_s3_list: Precision finishing of irregular shapes: people provide tactile control.
Clean edge finishing: people judge visually.
On-the-spot correction: people decide how to adjust.
Defect judgment: people identify rejects.
Quality control: people verify acceptable output.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation at low-moderate AI exposure. Systems accelerate cutting and inspection, while precision finishing and defect judgment still need people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure means the occupation remains viable. AI replaces routine rough cutting and defect sorting, not irregular-shape finishing. Workers who trim edges and identify defects become scarcer as productivity rises. Those limited to rough cutting face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Entry barriers are low, but tactile skill matters. Practice precision finishing on irregular shapes early. As routine work shrinks in the AI era, build defect-detection and correction skills.
Move from rough cutting to irregular-shape precision finishing + defect detection. Learn vision systems and work toward Team Lead roles.
Highlight edge-trimming and quality-inspection experience. Specify the materials you handled. Factories value steady, accurate work.
Do not hire on speed alone. Evaluate tactile control and precision. Skilled finishers deserve higher piece rates.

ai_s7_trends: Manufacturing fluctuations affect jobs.
Automation takes routine work; people handle precision finishing.
Workers skilled in irregular-shape finishing become more sought after.

body: Cutters And Trimmers, Hand use templates, process sheets, and hand tools to cut, trim, deburr, and correct materials or semi-finished products. They control dimensions, appearance, and acceptance quality.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Machine vision can flag defects, but a skilled worker still decides how to clean an edge and finish an irregular shape.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 视觉检能帮你挑次品，但边怎么修干净、异形怎么收，还是师傅一刀定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年切割工布置员、手工在岗约 0.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.57 万人，岗位净减约 0.13 万个，年均产生约 0.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.88 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代手工修整工，但会加速下料与检测。自动切割、视觉分拣把重复工作提速，修整工从「下大料」挪向「异形精修、辨疵、临场校正、质量把控」。真正被挤掉的是常规下料与简单挑疵，会异形修整的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助修边路径
瑕疵特征的智能识别
工艺参数的推荐
质量趋势的分析
ai_s2_auto: 自动切割下料
视觉分拣挑次品
尺寸公差的自动检
周转的自动码放
ai_s3_list: 异形精修：手感靠人。
边角收净：眼准靠人。
临场校正：咋修靠人定。
辨疵判断：次品靠人挑。
质量把控：合格靠人核。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的台前区——下料检测被系统加速，但精修与辨疵还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着岗位稳：被替代的是「常规下料与挑疵」动作，不是「异形精修」的岗位。会修边、能辨疵的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只下大料的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行门槛低但靠手感，早点练异形精修。AI 时代常规在缩，练辨疵和校正。
从「下料」升级成「异形精修 + 辨疵」，学视觉系统，争取做组长。
突出修边与质检经验，写清跟过哪些材料。厂里看重稳和准。
选人别只看速度，要看手感对不对。能精修的师傅，值得给高计件。

ai_s7_trends: 制造波动影响岗。
自动替常规，人做精修。
会异形修整的人更抢手。

body: 手工切割与修整工按样板与工艺单，用手动工具对材料或半成品进行切割、削边、修毛刺与校正，把控尺寸外观与合格。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 视觉检能帮你挑次品，但边怎么修干净、异形怎么收，还是师傅一刀定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can predict patient severity and plan a route, but an EMT must still hold a patient's hand and say, 'Don't be afraid. We will reach the hospital soon.'
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 181,000 Emergency Medical Technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 190,200 by 2034, a net gain of about 9,200 jobs, with about 14,100 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $41,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Emergency Medical Technicians. Dispatch optimization, AI-assisted triage, and telemedicine guidance will change how they work, but machines cannot replace on-scene assessment, emergency procedures, or communication with families. The tools are changing: AI speeds decisions and reduces documentation, while people remain the core of emergency response.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted triage that predicts case severity
Telemedicine guidance connecting field teams with hospital specialists
Smart devices that monitor CPR quality
Emergency-response data that improves procedures and training
ai_s2_auto: Automatic optimization of emergency dispatch and route planning
Automatic electronic filing of patient and treatment records
Automatic collection and upload of vital signs
Automatic monitoring and alerts for vehicle and equipment status
ai_s3_list: Rapid field assessment: training and experience set priorities within two minutes at a chaotic scene.
Stable emergency procedures: machines cannot perform CPR or control bleeding in a moving ambulance.
Patient and family communication: calming fear and distress is part of emergency care.
Real-time decisions: people adjust the treatment sequence when events depart from the plan.
Intuition about vital signs: experienced EMTs assess a patient's overall condition beyond monitor readings.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate exposure. Systems increasingly automate desk tasks such as dispatch, documentation, and data collection.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high replacement risk. AI assists decisions and efficiency, while people still perform core emergency procedures in the field. Pure documentation and dispatch work will shrink. EMTs who assess, treat, and communicate effectively become more valuable with AI support.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study nursing, emergency care, or a clinical field and earn an EMT credential early. Employers value psychological resilience and practical skills, so complete emergency training and volunteer service while studying.

Use AI-assisted triage and telemedicine tools, then progress toward paramedic, emergency nursing, or rescue-management roles. Move from emergency-care execution toward a combination of care, management, and training.

EMT training and credentialing are the main entry path, and a nursing background makes the transition easier. List response volume, cases handled, and credentials on your resume, and emphasize resilience under pressure.
Do not hire EMTs by credentials alone. Assess on-scene judgment and performance under pressure. Calm candidates who learn new tools add more value than people who only complete dispatch assignments.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time monitoring and transmission of vital signs
Real-time feedback on compression depth and rate
Integrated defibrillation, oxygen, and bleeding-control equipment

ai_s7_trends: AI triage and telemedicine become standard in emergency systems, shifting EMTs from experience-only judgment toward data-assisted field decisions.
Population aging increases emergency demand and supports stable long-term prehospital employment. Paramedic and rescue-management roles remain notably understaffed.
Smart CPR monitoring and remote patient monitoring are spreading, making equipment proficiency a new assessment area for EMTs.

body: Emergency Medical Technicians rapidly assess patients before hospital arrival, provide basic emergency care, and monitor transport. Their work includes CPR, bleeding control, bandaging, airway management, and transfer of information to hospitals.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can predict patient severity and plan a route, but an EMT must still hold a patient's hand and say, 'Don't be afraid. We will reach the hospital soon.'

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你预判病情、规划路线，但握着患者的手说「别怕，我们马上到医院」的那个人，还得是你。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年急诊医疗技术员在岗约 18.10 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 19.02 万人，净增约 0.92 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.13 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代急诊医疗技术员，这个岗位不可替代性很强。调度优化、AI 分诊辅助、远程医疗指导会改变工作方式，但现场评估、急救操作和与家属的沟通，是机器替代不了的。真正被改变的是工具：AI 让你判断更快、记录更省，人仍然是急救链条的核心。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助分诊，提前预判病情严重度
远程医疗指导连接院内专家
智能设备辅助心肺复苏质量监测
急救大数据指导流程与培训优化
ai_s2_auto: 急救调度与路线规划由系统自动优化
病历与处置记录电子化自动归档
生命体征数据自动采集上传
车辆与设备状态自动监测提醒
ai_s3_list: 现场快速评估：混乱现场里两分钟内分清优先级，靠的是训练和经验。
急救操作的稳定执行：颠簸车厢里心肺复苏、止血包扎，机器做不了。
与患者和家属的沟通：恐惧、情绪激动时的安抚，是急救的一部分。
临场决策：突发情况偏离预案时，怎么调整处置顺序靠人判断。
对生命体征的直觉：监护仪数据之外，患者状态好不好，老 EMT 一眼能感觉出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半桌面任务正被自动化——调度、记录、数据采集都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 辅助的是「决策和效率」，现场急救的核心动作仍然依赖人。真正被压缩的是纯记录和调度环节，会评估、会操作、会沟通的 EMT 反而因为 AI 的加持更有价值。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选护理、急救或临床相关专业，尽早考 EMT 资格。这行看重心理素质和实操，读书期间多参加急救培训与志愿者服务。
把 AI 辅助分诊、远程医疗这些新工具用起来，往高级急救员、急诊护士或救援管理方向提升。从「执行急救」升级为「急救+管理+培训」。
EMT 培训考证是入行主通道，有护理背景转得更顺。简历上多写「出勤次数、处置案例、持证类型」，并突出心理抗压能力。
招 EMT 别只看证书，要看现场评估能力和抗压性。能冷静处置、愿意学新工具的候选人，比只完成出勤任务的人更有价值。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 生命体征实时监测传输
按压深度频率实时反馈
除颤、供氧、止血装备一体化

ai_s7_trends: AI 分诊与远程医疗成为急救体系标配，EMT 从「凭经验判断」转向「数据辅助+现场决策」。
老龄化推高急救需求，院前急救岗位需求长期稳定，高级急救员与救援管理岗缺口明显。
急救设备智能化（CPR 监测、远程监护）普及，EMT 的装备使用能力成为新考核点。

body: 急诊医疗技术员负责在院前现场对伤病员进行快速评估、基础急救与转运监护，包括心肺复苏、止血包扎、气道管理及与医院的信息交接，是急救体系中最前线的专业技术岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你预判病情、规划路线，但握着患者的手说「别怕，我们马上到医院」的那个人，还得是你。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Film And Video Editors, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 43,500 Film And Video Editors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 45,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,700 jobs, with about 3,600 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $71,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Film And Video Editors, but it will reshape their workflow. Tools can handle repetitive and structured tasks, while people focus on judgment, accountability, and creativity. Editors who adapt storytelling to real contexts and make sound decisions gain value over those who only follow instructions.
ai_s2_accel: Use audience profiles and performance data to assess viewer needs faster.
Use simulations and rough cuts to test editing concepts.
Use retrieval tools to verify media references and rights requirements.
Use collaboration tools to coordinate editing across production teams.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured editing documents and reports.
Process and classify repetitive media data.
Perform preliminary rule-based footage screening and scheduling.
Search editing knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real editing projects.
The ability to explain editing decisions to non-specialists.
Accountability and final review in film and video editing.
Coordination of editing resources and stakeholders across boundaries.
Use of tacit knowledge built through long-term editing experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. AI can assist Film And Video Editors, but professional judgment and accountability for final review remain difficult to replace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 6/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong editing fundamentals and gain experience on real projects.
Connect existing experience to film and video editing and identify a distinct entry point.
Turn editing experience into repeatable products or management systems that increase leverage.
Use AI to reduce repetitive editing work and focus on creative decisions.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Core film and video editing work

ai_s7_trends: AI collaboration is becoming standard in editing, making tool literacy a basic requirement.
High-value editorial judgment and accountability are becoming scarcer.
Editing roles increasingly combine professional craft with management and product work.

body: Film And Video Editors shape raw footage into finished work with rhythm and emotion. They control narrative through shot order, pacing, music, and sound.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can instantly calculate a hundred scheduling options, but the question "Why don't the workshop masters like to follow the new process?" requires engineers to go to the site to discuss it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 351,100 industrial engineers on the job in 2024, and the number is expected to rise to 389,600 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 38,500 positions, an average annual vacancy of approximately 25,200, and a median annual salary of approximately US$101,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace industrial engineers, but it will take away the “calculation” part: data collection, bottleneck analysis, scheduling simulation, and report generation are all being automated. The remaining tasks of "judging which direction to change, how to get frontline cooperation, and how to implement the plan" still require people. Industrial engineers who can use AI to speed up can spend more time on real valuable on-site promotion.
ai_s2_accel: Digital twin simulates the entire production line, test run before making changes
Predictive maintenance exposes equipment bottlenecks in advance
AI vision identifies production line anomalies and motion waste
Supply chain data linkage to make global optimization suggestions
ai_s2_auto: Automatic collection of production line data and visual signage
Automatically generate simulations of production capacity and scheduling plans
Standard working hours calculation and report automation
Quality anomaly statistics and root cause screening
ai_s3_list: On-site observation: Squatting on the production line to watch workers operate, I discovered the invisible waste in the data.
Interpersonal facilitation: Convincing shop supervisors and workers to accept new processes.
Cross-department coordination: find a balance between quality, equipment, and procurement.
Business judgment: Know which optimizations are worth doing and which ones are false requirements.
Implementation ability: Break the plan into executable steps and complete the closed loop.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 shows that the "analysis layer" of industrial engineering is highly digitized, which is exactly what AI is best at: data collection, simulation scheduling, and report generation can all be handed over to tools. However, the weight of on-site diagnosis, plan promotion and organizational coordination "above analysis" has become heavier because of AI.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium and high exposure does not mean the disappearance of jobs: AI amplifies the production capacity of each engineer and also raises the threshold - those who can only make reports will be eliminated, and those who can "use AI analysis + rely on people to implement" will become scarce roles. Keep the black belt methods and field experience, AI is just your leverage.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Industrial engineering is a direction where "the older you get, the more valuable you become", and the undergraduate program has a wide range of employment options (manufacturing, logistics, and consulting are all accepted). If you want to get into the industry, you must first have a solid grasp of mathematics and statistics. During college, you should do more internships in factories, don't just sit in the computer room and model.

Be familiar with data analysis tools and AI scheduling software, and move towards lean and digital improvement. It is best to have a "completely implemented improvement project" in hand. Interviews and promotions are more convincing than certificates.

People with a manufacturing or supply chain background have an advantage in switching to IE. First, improve your process analysis and data skills, and get a Six Sigma Green Belt. When applying for a job, focus on "what you have improved and how much you have saved." Numbers are more useful than titles.

When recruiting industrial engineers, don't just look at academic qualifications and software skills. Focus on "cases that promoted implementation" - ask candidates which lines they have improved specifically and how they persuaded the front line to accept it. People who know AI tools but don’t have experience working on site should use them with caution.

Action disassembly and automatic calculation of standard working hours
Identify motion waste and operational deviations
Improve automatic generation of reports and minutes

ai_s7_trends: Digital twins and AI simulation have become standard features for factory improvement, and "test running before making changes" replaces patting your head.
Industrial engineers have shifted from "calculating data" to "setting direction + pushing implementation", and the weight of communication and organizational skills has increased.
The combination of lean methods and AI makes "data problem-finding + people make decisions" become a new work paradigm.

body: Industrial engineers use mathematics, statistics and engineering methods to optimize production and service systems, design more efficient processes, layouts, schedules and resource allocations, and reduce time and costs while ensuring quality. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工业工程师在岗约 35.11 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 38.96 万人，净增约 3.85 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.52 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.11 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代工业工程师，但会把「算」的部分拿掉：数据采集、瓶颈分析、排程模拟、报表生成都在自动化。剩下的「判断往哪个方向改、怎么让一线配合、怎么把方案落地」依然要人。会借 AI 提速的工业工程师，能把更多时间花在真正值钱的现场推动上。

预测性维护提前暴露设备瓶颈
AI 视觉识别产线异常与动作浪费
供应链数据联动做全局优化建议

产能与排程方案自动生成模拟
标准工时测算与报表自动化
质量异常统计与根因初筛

人际推动：说服车间主管和工人接受新流程。
跨部门协调：在质量、设备、采购之间找到平衡点。

落地能力：把方案拆成可执行的步骤并盯完闭环。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明工业工程的「分析层」高度数据化，恰恰是 AI 最擅长的地方：数据采集、模拟排程、报表生成都能交给工具。但「分析之上」的现场诊断、方案推动与组织协调，权重反而因为 AI 变得更重。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于岗位消失：AI 把每个工程师的产能放大，也把门槛抬高——只会做报表的会被淘汰，能「用 AI 分析 + 靠人落地」的会变成稀缺角色。把黑带方法和现场经验留住，AI 只是你的杠杆。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 工业工程是「越老越值钱」的方向，本科就业面宽（制造、物流、咨询都认）。想入行先把数学和统计打扎实，大学期间多进工厂实习，别只坐在机房建模。
把数据分析工具和 AI 排程软件用熟，往精益和数字化改善方向走。手里最好有一个「完整落地的改善项目」，面试和晋升都比证书有说服力。
有制造业或供应链背景的人转 IE 有优势。先补流程分析与数据技能，考个六西格玛绿带，求职时重点讲「你改进过什么、省了多少」，数字比头衔管用。
招工业工程师别只看学历和软件技能，重点考察「推动落地的案例」——问候选人具体改进过哪条线、怎么说服一线接受。会 AI 工具但不下现场的人要慎用。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can process similar cases and documents very quickly, but "how to decide this case" still has to be decided by the judge.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 27,300 judges and magistrates employed in 2024, projected to reach 28,000 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 700 jobs, with roughly 900 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $156,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI won’t replace judges, but it will redo transactional work. After similar case retrieval, document generation, and evidence sorting are handed over to AI, the judge moves from "turning over files" to "making fact determinations, exercising discretion, and writing high-quality reasoning." What is really scarce are referees who can uphold procedures and values ​​in difficult situations.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent distillation of controversial issues
Reference ranges for sentencing and compensation
Proofreading assistance for document reasoning
Suggestions on the separation of complex and simplified cases
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent retrieval of similar cases and legal provisions

Court review and process reminders
ai_s3_list: Fact determination: How to accept evidence depends on human judgment.
Discretion: The importance of circumstances depends on experience.
Value balance: Legal principles and human feelings must be balanced.
Trial control: On-site order and emergencies depend on people.
Responsibility is fully understood: responsibility is taken when the hammer falls, and machines cannot replace it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 shows that this profession is in the mid-to-high-exposure transaction processing area-retrieval and drafting can be accelerated, but the referee and discretion are still left to humans.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But medium and high exposure does not mean high risk: what is replaced is "checking information and writing a first draft", not "making a ruling". Judges who can adjudicate difficult cases and write thorough reasoning are even rarer. What I'm afraid of are the paperwork posts that only use templates.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Get a foundation in law, pass the law exam as early as possible, and write more cases and documents in school. The AI ​​era is all about discretion and reasoning, don’t just be a searcher.
Start as an assistant, familiarize yourself with the AI ​​search tool, focus on fact identification and document quality, and strive to get admitted as soon as possible.
Highlight your legal examination, trial assistance and clerical experience. Priority will be given to those who have difficult case experience.
Select people based on their reasoning and discretion skills, not just the number of cases they handle. A judge who can write a thorough decision is worthy of the burden.

ai_s7_trends: Smart courts have significantly reduced administrative work.
Similar case retrieval and document generation have been improved, and document positions have been expanded.
Referees who can solve difficult problems and write thorough reasoning are even rarer.

选人看说理与裁量能力，不止看办案数量。能写透判决的法官值得压担子。

能办疑难、写透说理的裁判者更稀缺。

Reader service, reading programs, and incident response remain because they require judgment and empathy.

Intelligent shelving recommendations and misplaced-item detection support shelf organization

Detailed classification and shelving work: machines cannot bind, repair, and preserve physical materials.
Program and reading-promotion execution: people set up, guide, and manage participants to deliver an event.
Reader trust: patient guidance for older adults and children creates service quality.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score means most desk-based transactions are rule-driven. Systems and AI efficiently take over cataloging, research, and statistics.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. As self-service and AI spread, more readers need help using unfamiliar systems. Pure operational roles face pressure, while versatile technicians who understand technology and provide service gain importance.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study library and information science, archives, or digital publishing and complete multiple internships. Do not focus only on cataloging, which will become more automated. Reader service, reading programs, and digital-resource management create future competitiveness.

Master collection systems and data analysis and proactively take on reading programs and events. Shifting from managing books to managing reader experience turns a replaceable operator into a resilient service professional.

Library roles have accessible entry thresholds but scarce established positions. Government-contracted services or corporate information centers can provide alternative entry routes. Quantify reader consultations, programs organized, and processes improved on your resume.

Do not hire technicians only for cataloging. Evaluate communication ability and willingness to learn. Candidates who cover public service, run programs, and learn new systems are more valuable than mechanical operators.
